query:
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_matches
                              WHERE state = 'matched'
                                AND ((poster_plugin = ?1 AND poster = ?2)
                                     OR (backdrop_plugin = ?1 AND backdrop = ?2)
                                     OR (logo_plugin = ?1 AND logo = ?2)
                                     OR (plugin = ?1 AND still = ?2)))
               AS "stored!: bool"
